evidence.note: Reviewed the shard-pack wiring added to Create: plan, ingest, write, rollback, prune and GC ordering.
Read the new table test that claims to cover prune and gc housekeeping failures.
internal/taskdone floor raised to 89.4 by this branch; go test ./internal/taskdone reports 81.9% package coverage locally, and go tool cover puts Create at 83.0% and ingestShardResults at 88.9%.

Verified against the working tree: go vet ./internal/taskdone is clean and go test ./internal/taskdone passes; an aggregated coverage profile over ./... was used to identify which new statements are never executed.

findings.note: The 'gc' case of TestTaskDoneHousekeepingFailuresDoNotDiscardTheRun cannot fail. GC is only called when !result.Blocking (internal/taskdone/review.go:269-271), but every sharded task-done run in these tests emits a context-risk blocker, so packWriter.GC is never invoked: an aggregated coverage profile over ./... shows review.go:270 with count 0 across the whole test suite, and fakeWriter.gcErr therefore never reaches the code under test. The subtest is byte-for-byte equivalent to the 'prune' subtest and would still pass if a GC error were propagated as a run failure. The one place GC's absence is asserted is the negative check at shardwiring_test.go:177. Either drive a passing sharded run (supply shard results via found/ShardResultPaths so result.Blocking is false) or assert writer.collections == 1 in the gc case.

fakeWriter.discoverErr and fakeWriter.found are dead test seams: no test ever sets them (grep over internal/taskdone/shardwiring_test.go finds only the declarations at lines 30-31 and the returns at line 56). As a result the Discover error propagation added by this diff (review.go:283-285 into Create at review.go:144-145) is never exercised, and neither is the manifest path where shard results are actually present, so manifestContext's Present/Verdict/ShardsCovered plumbing is only ever observed in its empty state from this package.

Rollback error handling is inconsistent between the two failure paths added here. The review-body failure path joins the rollback error onto the original (review.go:257-259), but the pack-write failure path discards it with '_ = packRollback()' (review.go:163-168). If the rollback of a failed pack write itself fails, the pack directory is left in a half-restored state with no signal in the returned error. The errors.Join branch at review.go:258 is also uncovered by any test.
